settings.heading: Visit Us
settings.accent: Two blocks from the harbor, right on Marion Ave
settings.text: Come try things on, bring a friend, and let us style you in person. Free street parking on Marion Ave and in the public lots one block over. Ordered online? Choose in-store pickup at checkout and we'll have it ready at the counter.

settings.heading: Can I pick up an online order in store?
settings.row_content: Yes — pick In-store pickup at checkout. We'll text or email when it's ready, usually the same business day. Pickups are held for 14 days.

settings.heading: Do you offer private styling or group shopping?
settings.row_content: We love a girls' night. Call (941) 369-1628 or message us on Facebook to book a private hour before or after regular hours — bridal parties, birthdays, or just you and your best friend.

settings.heading: Where do I park?
settings.row_content: Free street parking along Marion Ave and in the public lots a block toward the harbor. Downtown Punta Gorda is flat and walkable — make an afternoon of it.
